what: wasm bytes og-physics (rapier3d/rapier2d 0.36.1, enhanced-determinism, serde) adds to a cdylib that already links og-core and og-ecs
method: a probe cdylib outside the workspace (path deps on og-core, og-ecs, og-physics at 49ed935; the workspace Cargo.lock; release opt-level 3, thin LTO, codegen-units 1) exporting run(ticks, profile): base steps an og-ecs world, snapshots and restores; the physics variants also install og.physics, spawn every primitive shape plus a trimesh and a convex hull, step, raycast and snapshot/restore. cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown [--features p3d|p2d|p2d,p3d]; wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int; brotli -q 11 (the gate's pipeline, without wasm-bindgen)
note: og-host-web does not link og-physics at 49ed935, so the size gate (size-gate.json) does not include it; the projection adds the measured delta to the gate's og_host_web.wasm and is within the 4 MB core budget even with both profiles. Rust 1.97.0, Apple M4 Pro, 2026-10-18.
